theme: Light mode primary with warm slate tones and energetic puzzle-piece brand accents

branding.logo_identity: Heart composed of colorful puzzle pieces (Cyan, Electric Blue, Magenta/Pink, Deep Purple gradient) with wordmark 'instituto' (cyan) 'motivar' (deep blue).
branding.core_mission: Nonprofit Brazilian association dedicated to comprehensive social care across all causes: neurodiversity (TEA/autism), legal assistance, vulnerability relief, child education, and family support.

scale.hero_title: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-none

layout_patterns.header: Crystal Glassmorphism navbar with logo SVG heart puzzle, responsive desktop menu links (Quem Somos, Atendimentos, Ações, Como Ajudar, Transparência, Contato), PIX fast-donate button, and Admin Login trigger.
layout_patterns.hero: Asymmetric Bento Hero section featuring high-impact photo of smiling community children, live impact metrics floating badge (+1.200 famílias atendidas, +300 assistências jurídicas, 100% trabalho voluntário), primary CTA 'Doar via PIX' and secondary CTA 'Conhecer Projetos'.
layout_patterns.quem_somos: Split grid with President Profile (Dra. Ana Paula M. / Leadership bio + photo) alongside the 4 foundational pillars of Instituto Motivar.
layout_patterns.o_que_fazemos: Care categories grid with interactive category selector: 1. Acolhimento Neurodiverso (TEA/Autismo & Síndromes), 2. Assistência Jurídica Gratuita, 3. Apoio a Famílias em Vulnerabilidade, 4. Atividades Recreativas e Esportivas, 5. Cestas Básicas e Agasalhos.
layout_patterns.acoes_sociais: Filterable gallery of social projects with live status badges (Concluído / Em Andamento / Recorrente), impact summary, and photo gallery viewer modal.
layout_patterns.como_ajudar: Interactive Donation Hub featuring instant QR Code & Copy-Paste PIX key generator, volunteer signup form, and transparency commitment.
layout_patterns.cms_admin: Protected CMS Dashboard modal/route for institute managers to edit photo gallery, create new social actions, modify president bio, and update emergency phone/WhatsApp numbers.

component_instructions.interactive_pix_copy: Provide a clean copy-to-clipboard button with Sonner toast alert ('Chave PIX copiada com sucesso!') for quick mobile donations.
component_instructions.cms_dashboard: Provide state persistence in LocalStorage so edits to projects, photos, and texts survive page refreshes.
component_instructions.testing_attributes: Include explicit data-testid attributes on all main elements (e.g. data-testid='pix-copy-button', data-testid='admin-login-button', data-testid='project-card-0', data-testid='volunteer-submit-btn').

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Always use cohesive light theme with rich micro-interactions and smooth transitions.
Never use generic placeholder text; provide meaningful Portuguese copy for Instituto Motivar.
Include full testability attributes (data-testid) across all user actions.
Use standard icons from lucide-react or phosphor icons.
Maintain strict optical padding inside bordered cards.
